Selective demolition is the process of carefully removing specific parts of a structure while preserving the areas that will remain intact. It allows homeowners, contractors, and property managers to prepare spaces for renovation without damaging the rest of the building.

text: Removing only what needs replacement minimizes labor, disposal costs, and rebuilding expenses.

items.title: Protecting Valuable Structures
text: Walls, flooring, electrical systems, plumbing, and structural components that remain in good condition can often be preserved.

items.title: Improving Renovation Efficiency
text: Contractors can begin remodeling work faster when demolition is completed carefully and strategically.

items.title: Minimizing Waste
text: By removing only targeted materials, less debris ends up in landfills.
